 Watch Community Theatre-Themed The Debut Trailer , Starring Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti
 Jesse Eisenberg's film also features Bernadette Peters, Halle Bailey, Cara Buono, Craig Bierko, and Eldar Isgandarov.
 November 10, 2026 
 By Andrew Gans 
 A community theatre production takes center stage in the new A24 film  The Debut, which will be released in movie theatres December 11. Watch the official trailer in the video above.
 Written and directed by Jesse Eisenberg , the cast features Eisenberg as well as Academy Award winner  Julianne Moore , Paul Giamatti , Halle Bailey, Cara Buono , Craig Bierko , Eldar Isgandarov, and three-time Tony honoree  Bernadette Peters .
 READ: Bernadette Peters, Rachel Dratch, More Will Be Part of Final Season of Netflix's A Man on the Inside 
 The Debut follows Mona Friedman (Moore), who is cast in a bit part at a small community theatre. She transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.
 Oscar winner Moore will also lead Faydra , a world premiere from Sarah Ruhl , heading Off-Broadway via Manhattan Theatre Club this winter. The production, to be directed by Les Waters , will play a limited engagement at New York City Center Stage I beginning February 2, 2027.
 Visit  A24films.com .
